title: Publication Verdict
description: Whether a published port actually served its gap on the real path. Publishing is not success and attaching is not success: an unverified verdict names the exact kernel calls that withdraw the port. The limb names them; the operator runs them, through the public CLI.

retire_calls.description: Empty when retained. Otherwise the `neuron port detach` and `neuron port revoke` invocations that withdraw the edge and the record.

probe.description: The observation this verdict is grounded in, carried forward so the verdict is auditable without the probe artifact.
